notes: Main recruitment. Meta city targets with no radius (Meta's own city area) from the second day; the first day ($14 of spend) used 10-mile radius areas. From 6 to 18 Dec the ad sets labelled Jeddah aimed at Mecca: those days are counted as Mecca (cells flagged label_jeddah_aimed_at_mecca), split at the configuration change (people by first-answer time, spend by Insights day, so the 18 Dec day goes to Mecca). The quota rule changed twice; counted under the final rule. Citizenship was asked, not screened. Ads cost more per person who started than in the other countries here (clicks $0.21 against $0.03-0.11 in the Dec 2025 runs); the cause is not known. Question count: questions shown on the main path, including the language choice where there is one and conditional follow-ups; statements, error repeats and unshown branches not counted.

For the first week the ad sets also used Meta's parent-of-young-child targeting (flag interests_part_of_run). Daily spend per ad set was very small, so every cell is thin. Four of the Mediterranean radius areas are in Antalya province, which is in no region's whole-region targeting.

The adopt reports do not reconcile: one sibling's latest report is stale with zero spend, another covers part of the run.
